Hover effects

Add `.hover-zoom` or `.hover-rotate` to `.card-img-top` for image effects on card hover. Combine with `.ease-linear` or `.ease-bounce` for different feels.

ZoomGradient Top
.hover-zoom

Scales up 1.12x. .gradient-top fades toward the top.

RotateTeal Gradient
.hover-rotate

Rotates 2.5°. .gradient-teal gives a teal-tinted overlay.

Zoom + RotateBounce
Zoom + Rotate + Bounce

Combined with .ease-bounce for a springy feel.

ZoomLinear
Zoom + Linear

.hover-zoom.ease-linear for constant speed zoom.

Show / Hide text on hover

Add `.hover-show` to hide text by default and reveal on card hover. Add `.hover-hide` to show text by default and hide on hover.

ShowDescription

A hidden description that appears when you hover over this card.

ShowCaption

A caption fades in on hover — great for revealing additional context.
